One view of mobile asset condition — decision support, not an authoritative work list

A point-in-time snapshot extracted from seven Roy Hill semantic models — Wenco time usage, SAP PM notifications and work orders, OEM onboard alarms, oil analysis, tyre risk, undercarriage wear and the MEM execution MTBF split — joined on the asset. It does not refresh on its own. Health is scored across three pillars with a weakest-link rule, so a strong pillar can never mask a failing one. Condition concern is an ordinal rule score, not a calibrated probability of failure. Advisory only — nothing writes back to SAP or Wenco.
